{{Top|leg}}
A '''chaal stick''' was a type of item that could be used as a makeshift weapon. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a number of patrons of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Building 49-A]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] clutched chaal sticks during a standoff with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lo Pelkar]] and [[Rulo]].
